request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Snowdrift Lynx".

Creative brief
Name: Snowdrift Lynx
Collection: Frostveil Pack. Cold-climate animals adapted to blizzards, frozen lakes, icicles, and delayed shattering projectile patterns.
Core concept: A concealed ambusher whose movement is revealed by a raised trail of snow.
Body and silhouette: Compact feline with long legs, broad paws, short tail, and tall ear tufts.
Signature features: Snow-covered back, oversized paw prints, and icy ear crystals.
Palette and materials: Off-white, pale gray, muted blue, and charcoal.
Movement personality: Silent, patient, and explosively quick.
Attack concept: Burrows beneath a snowdrift while leaving a visible moving mound, then erupts and releases a five-shot fan.
Directional details: The right ear tuft is tipped in dark charcoal.
Avoid: Invisible ambush, domestic cat proportions, excessive fluffy detail.
